subject: Synapse discovery — commitments, milestones, and MPA (next steps)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@synapse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.c@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Synapse discovery — recap and proposed MPA (draft)

Alex — thanks for a focused call this morning. Quick recap of the pain, goals, and the mutual action plan we discussed. Please review and flag anything I missed or owners you'd like to change.

Key pain points you emphasized:
- Latency spikes on peak traffic (p95 currently ~480ms for conversational flows) impacting conversion.
- Cost unpredictability as model use scales — engineering team wants clear unit economics.
- Regulatory requirement for data residency and audit logs (SOC 2 evidence required).
- Need for predictable batch throughput for overnight batch enrichment jobs.

Primary success criteria for a pilot:
- p95 inference latency < 200ms on production-like traffic for the primary endpoint.
- Unit cost reduction target ~30% vs current hosted baseline.
- Security review passed (SOC 2 artifact + network control checklist).
- Pilot ingests representative dataset (anonymized) and runs edge-case prompts defined by your team.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MPA) — milestones, owners, and dates (draft):
1) Confirm pilot scope and data access (Synapse owner: Alex Johnson) — target: 2026-10-26
2) Security questionnaire / evidence handoff (Synapse: Procurement; Redwood: Ben Carter) — target: 2026-11-15
3) Pilot environment provisioned (private VPC option) & baseline tests (Redwood: Marissa Cole) — target: 2026-11-30
4) Pilot run (3 weeks) & evaluation (joint) — 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-21
5) Procurement & legal sign-off (Synapse legal + Redwood) — target: 2027-01-12
6) Decision to move to dedicated capacity / production rollout — target: 2027-02-01

Redwood owners referenced above:
- Ben Carter — commercial / procurement coordination
- Marissa Cole — solutions engineering / pilot delivery
- Neha Kapoor — engagement owner / exec sync
- Soojin Lee — customer success / onboarding plan

Attachments: synapse_mpa_v1.xlsx (MPA table + milestone gantt), redwood_sow_v0.9.pdf (SOW draft)

Ask: please confirm the milestones above, add any missing stakeholders (legal, procurement contact, billing), and let us know if you prefer adjustments to the dates. If this looks good, Ben and I will circulate an updated MPA with a shared Drive link and slot a security scoping call for next week.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.k@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@synapse.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@synapse.ai>, Katherine Lee <k.lee@synapse.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Synapse discovery — recap and proposed MPA (draft)

Neha — thanks for the crisp summary. A few notes and requests:

1) Buyers / stakeholders to add:
   - Katherine Lee (CTO) — technical approval for latency targets.
   - Raj Patel (Head of Procurement) — procurement lead (cc'd procurement@).
   - Legal: legal@synapse.ai (we'll need a ~2 week review window once SOW is exchanged).

2) Security evidence: SOC 2 report will be required. Procurement has asked if we can move the security review target up to 2026-11-10 — we prefer to have security gating earlier to unblock pilot infra. Is that feasible?

3) Pilot scope: we want the pilot to include both hosted and private VPC runs so we can compare latency/cost tradeoffs. Please add a short A/B split step during the 3-week run.

4) Can you include a billing contact? Our finance lead (finance@synapse.ai) will need rough cost estimates for internal approval.

I reviewed the attached MPA spreadsheet quickly — looks good as a draft. If Redwood can accommodate the earlier security window (11/10), we can commit to the December pilot window.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Platform Engineering | Synapse AI
alex.j@synapse.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@synapse.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.l@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Synapse discovery — recap and proposed MPA (draft)

Alex — appreciate the quick turn. A few clarifications and updates from our side after syncing with Product and Security:

- Security review: we can aim to complete the initial questionnaire + SOC 2 artifact handoff by 2026-11-10 as requested. To meet that timeline we'll need the completed security questionnaire from your procurement team by 2026-10-27.

- Pilot split: confirmed — we'll include an A/B comparison (hosted vs private VPC). Marissa will own the test plan and provide a short runbook for both environments.

- Dates: moving procurement sign-off earlier to 2027-01-12 is reasonable. If legal needs extra time, please flag expected review windows so we can adjust the procurement milestone.

- Billing & cost estimates: attaching a short cost sheet in the Drive link (see Related Links) — it includes conservative and aggressive cost profiles for the pilot. Finance contact requested: finance@synapse.ai (we'll cc on later threads).

- Owners we will list formally in the MPA: Marissa Cole (Redwood SE, pilot delivery), Soojin Lee (Redwood CS), Ben Carter (Redwood commercial lead), Neha Kapoor (engagement).

I've uploaded an updated MPA (v1.1) to the Drive with the adjusted dates and an action column. Link below. HubSpot deal ID is SYNP-2026-0421 for reference.

Attachments referenced: synapse_mpa_v1.xlsx (v1.1 in Drive)

Next steps I propose:
- Synapse: confirm procurement + legal contacts and provide completed security questionnaire by 2026-10-27
- Redwood: schedule a 60-minute security scoping call (Marissa + Security SME) for week of 2026-10-31
- Neha & Ben: align calendar for an exec sync week of 2026-11-07 (confirmable once security call date is set)

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.c@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0166
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@synapse.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.p@synapse.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@synapse.ai>, legal@synapse.ai, finance@synapse.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Synapse discovery — recap and proposed MPA (draft)

Thanks Ben / Neha — that timeline works from our side. Confirming:

- Procurement contact: Raj Patel (raj.p@synapse.ai) — Raj will own the security questionnaire delivery (target 2026-10-27).
- Legal contact: legal@synapse.ai (please send SOW to this address when ready for redline).
- Finance: finance@synapse.ai (please include cost sheet from Redwood).
- CTO approval: Katherine Lee will review latency targets during the security scoping call.

I'm OK for Redwood to proceed with scheduling the security scoping call week of 2026-10-31. We expect the SOC 2 artifact to be available via a secure link (we will share an FTP/Drive address).

One small request: can you include a short success criteria checklist in the MPA for the pilot evaluation (latency, throughput, cost delta, feature coverage)? That will help Katherine and our engineering leads sign off quickly.

If you send the Drive link and updated MPA I will circulate internally and confirm names for any additional reviewers.

Appreciate the quick responses — Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Platform Engineering | Synapse AI
alex.j@synapse.ai
